summary.name: Affinity Designer
summary.one_liner: Affinity Designer is a vector and graphic design application from Serif, described on this page as free professional software for precise vector art, illustration, and UI work.
use_cases: generating editable vectors from text prompts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes vector design with pen-level node and curve editing, snapping and alignment tools, and symbols and constraints to keep icons and UI components consistent across artboards. It supports warping shapes, expanding or contracting paths, and expressive brushes for illustration. Non-destructive editing and real-time pixel previews are mentioned, along with export. It also offers an AI Generate Vector feature that creates editable, node-based vectors from a prompt, and it lists Pixel, Vector, and Layout studios.
notable: Free to use with all Pixel, Vector, and Layout studio tools, per the FAQ
Generate Vector creates editable node-based vectors from a text prompt
Symbols and constraints keep icons and UI components consistent across artboards
Canva premium plan users can access Canva AI tools inside Affinity via Canva AI Studio
caveats: Canva AI Studio integration requires a Canva premium plan (Pro, Business, Enterprise, or Education)
Platforms are only named as Mac in the awesome-mac listing; the page itself does not list platforms
